explanation: The recorded descent established retention, but release was blocked by uncertainty extrapolated from a narrow tracked patch. No visual-review calls remain. This repair uses the supplied frame-357 images as explicit, frame-locked measurement selections, refreshes the visible carton edge and interior plane with current RGB-D, and performs at most one small, previously supported centering correction. It does not lower the failed uncertainty threshold. Release still requires measured aperture and height margins. Fresh registration, a supported open-hand retreat, and repeated textured RGB-D measurements assess actual detachment, containment, and stability without another review call. Historical retention and geometry retain their provenance; an unavailable correspondence is not replaced by commanded motion.
interface: main(api) and completion_proposed/evidence are unchanged. Two exact source replacements add a zero-review-budget continuation only for the checkpointed held state matching the supplied frame 357. Current image selections are invalidated if that frame or saved physical state differs. The continuation uses api.cloud, api.point, api.plane_point, geo.plane, geo.transform, geo.attachment_error, and the existing finger-envelope calculation. A bounded pad-center drive handles the small centering correction. Checkpoints record fresh reference geometry, release intent, and final evidence. Tracker failure can use independent semantic-landmark review when budget permits; after opening, a supported view change and independently compared fixed-camera RGB-D patch provide additional recovery. If those measurements cannot resolve registration or stability, the method reports the specific remaining gap without asserting completion.
jev_protocol: Existing seven-axis/gripper Jev questions and literal choices are preserved. Axis instructions explicitly select the corresponding increase/decrease/within_tolerance relation; the gripper selects open, close, or keep from its objective. Numerical geometry, tolerances, pad offsets, and residuals are computed in code. The new centering lease sends its measured correction and uncertainty, preserves orientation and grasp, and stops on stalled motion, exhausted progress, or an unexpected gripper choice. Opening occurs only after current numerical release gates pass. Subsequent open-hand motion is the previously reviewed local upward retreat, not an unseen-route clearance claim. Measured object motion, finger separation, containment geometry, and fixed-camera RGB-D stability are separate gates; neither a delivered command nor a reached pose establishes their truth.
